title: Musa, Part 5: Facing Pharaoh

lines.text: Allah sent Musa and Harun to Pharaoh, with a surprising command.
lines.spoken: Allah sent Musa and Haaroon to Pharaoh, with a surprising command.

lines.text: "Speak to him gently, so perhaps he will remember, or fear."
lines.spoken: "Speak to him gently, so perhaps he will remember, or fear."

lines.text: They said: "Our Lord, we fear he will harm us."
lines.spoken: They said: "Our Lord, we fear he will harm us."

lines.text: "Do not fear," Allah said. "I am with you both, I hear and I see."
lines.spoken: "Do not fear," Allah said. "I am with you both, I hear and I see."

lines.text: They told Pharaoh: "We are your Lord's messengers. Let the Children of Israel go with us."
lines.spoken: They told Pharaoh: "We are your Lord's messengers. Let the Children of Israel go with us."

lines.text: Pharaoh said: "Did we not raise you among us as a child?"
lines.spoken: Pharaoh said: "Did we not raise you among us as a child?"

lines.text: "So who is your Lord, Musa?" he asked.
lines.spoken: "So who is your Lord, Musa?" he asked.

lines.text: Musa said: "Our Lord gave everything its form, then guided it."
lines.spoken: Musa said: "Our Lord gave everything its form, then guided it."

lines.text: Pharaoh threatened: "Take a god other than me, and I will imprison you."
lines.spoken: Pharaoh threatened: "Take a god other than me, and I will imprison you."

lines.text: Musa threw his staff, and it became an unmistakable serpent.
lines.spoken: Musa threw his staff, and it became an unmistakable serpent.

lines.text: He drew out his hand, and it shone white for all to see.
lines.spoken: He drew out his hand, and it shone white for all to see.

lines.text: Allah showed Pharaoh all His signs, yet he denied and refused.
lines.spoken: Allah showed Pharaoh all His signs, yet he denied and refused.

lines.text: What would he do next? Follow for Part 6.
lines.spoken: What would he do next? Follow for Part six.
